definitions.gloss: to add in writing; to write more
definitions.explanation: To supplement existing text by writing additional content.

examples.japanese: ⟦{報告書|ほうこくしょ}→報告書：06744_houkokusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{補足|ほそく}→補足：08386_hosoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added a supplement to the report.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われて→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added more explanation as the teacher told me to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日記|にっき}→日記：01486_nikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す。
examples.english: I'll add yesterday's events to my diary.

examples.japanese: ⟦{申込書|もうしこみしょ}→申込書：03162_moushikomisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I was told to add my contact information to the application form.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{書|か}き{足|た}した。
examples.english: I added "let's meet again" at the end of the letter.

notes:
A compound verb meaning to add something in writing to what already exists. From ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (to write) + ⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧ (to add, to supplement). The base text is already there; this verb covers only the increment.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the content added: ⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す
- Takes ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for what it is added to: ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す

ASPECT (ている):
{書|か}き{足|た}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ means "is in the process of adding" (ongoing action).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add to a text)
- ⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add reasons in writing)
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add to notes)
- ⟦{一言|ひとこと}→一言：03708_hitokoto⟧{書|か}き{足|た}す (to add a brief note)

THE ～{足|た}す PATTERN:
As a second element, ⟦{足|た}す→足す：01168_tasu⟧ means "do some more of it on top of what is already there":
- ⟦{言|い}い{足|た}す→言い足す：30546_iitasu⟧ (to add verbally)
- ⟦{付|つ}け{足|た}す→付け足す：06863_tsuketasu⟧ (to append, to add on)
- ⟦{買|か}い{足|た}す→買い足す：30283_kaitasu⟧ (to buy additional items)
